items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: you picked up Jessie Price as the drummer who replaced Bill Beeson

ctx.x: Well, what I wanted to do is go back to the tour after Chick's demise -- after you left the Savoy Ballroom.
And you went to Kansas City where you picked up Jessie Price as the drummer who replaced Bill Beeson.
You were on your way to California --
